name: XLA_CONTROL_BALANCES
description: This table contains the third party control balances.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Self-contained accounting information set for single or multiple legal or management entities.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Account code combination identifier.

columns.name: PARTY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Classification used to categorize a party. For example, organization, individual, group, or relationship.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Identifier that refers to any business unit or organization representing both sides of a contract, whether internal or external.

columns.name: PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.description: Identifier that refers to the name given to represent the location where a person or organization can be reached.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Fiscal period that reports financial results, such as a calendar month or fiscal period.

columns.name: BEGINNING_BALANCE_DR
columns.description: Debit balance at the beginning of the general ledger period.

columns.name: BEGINNING_BALANCE_CR
columns.description: Credit balance at the beginning of the general ledger period.

columns.name: PERIOD_BALANCE_DR
columns.description: Debit balance for the current general ledger period.

columns.name: PERIOD_BALANCE_CR
columns.description: Credit balance for the current general ledger period.

columns.name: DRAFT_BEGINNING_BALANCE_DR
columns.description: Draft debit balance at the beginning of the general ledger period.

columns.name: DRAFT_BEGINNING_BALANCE_CR
columns.description: Draft credit balance at the beginning of the general ledger period.

columns.name: PERIOD_DRAFT_BALANCE_DR
columns.description: Draft debit balance for the current general ledger period.

columns.name: PERIOD_DRAFT_BALANCE_CR
columns.description: Draft credit balance for the current general ledger period.

columns.name: INITIAL_BALANCE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this is the beginning account balance for the general ledger account and ledger.

columns.name: FIRST_PERIOD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this is the first period in a fiscal year for which balances have been calculated.

columns.name: PERIOD_YEAR
columns.description: Fiscal year a company uses to report financial results.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Period when a transaction is effective.

columns.name: PARTITION_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Partition grouping information, when combined with the period, determines the database partition in which this balance will be stored.
